rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved CE: academic MFT courses (15 h per credit hour), seminars/workshops/courses, home study with posttest (without posttest max 10); limited credit for cross-disciplinary, self-directed, supervision provided (15) or received toward supervisor approval (8), teaching, publications, professional organizations
rules.audit_note: Records may be requested by the board at least 30 days before license expiration.

topics.who: Professional ethics of the MFT profession, formal training

rules.notes: At least 6 of the 40 hours on diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders (formal training; no topic code). Credit in 15-min increments. Board site ksbsrb.ks.gov returned 403 to our checker; cycle dates, fees and audit details not confirmed.
